filter_error.reindexing: That field is being reindexed right now and cannot be filtered on yet. Try again shortly.
filter_error.unsupported_op: That condition isn't supported for this field.
filter_error.not_indexed: That field isn't indexed, so it can't be filtered or sorted on.

editor.data_help: Raw JSON for this record's fields. Switching back re-fills the form from it.
editor.slug_help: The address this record gets in a public URL.
editor.slug_help_derived: Leave blank to derive it from {field}.
editor.position_help: Orders this record in a public list. Leave it at 0 to sort by date.
editor.locale_badge_help: This record's language is fixed for its lifetime.
editor.unique_in_trash: A record with this value already exists — it may be in the Trash. Open the Trash and either restore it and change its value, or delete it permanently to release the value.
editor.slug_collision_help: Change the Title, or set a distinct Slug under Advanced.
editor.conflict_title: This record changed while you were editing
editor.conflict_help: Someone else saved a change to this record since you opened it. Reload to see the latest version, or overwrite it with what you have.
editor.schema_stale: Fields changed since this was saved
editor.confirm_purge: This cannot be undone. Delete this record permanently?

invalid.title: This record does not satisfy the current schema

revisions.title: History
revisions.restore_schema_mismatch: This version no longer fits the type's current schema.
revisions.restore_schema_mismatch_detail: This version no longer fits the type's current schema: {detail}

errors.offline: Couldn't reach the server. Your changes are still on this page; try again.
errors.session_expired: Your session has expired. Taking you to the sign-in page — your changes are still on this page until you leave it.

type_editor.key_immutable: The key can't be changed once the type is created.
type_editor.key_new_help: Lowercase letters, numbers and underscores, starting with a letter. Chosen once — this can't be changed later.

type_key_error.pattern: Must start with a lowercase letter, and contain only lowercase letters, numbers and underscores.
type_key_error.duplicate: Another type already uses this key.

type_editor.icon_help: One of the framework's navigation icons — {examples} and about sixty more — rather than any lucide-react name. Also used for this type's sidebar entry when "Show in sidebar" is on.
type_editor.icon_unknown: "{name}" is not one of the framework's navigation icons, so "{fallback}" is drawn wherever this type is listed.
type_editor.is_public_help: Exposes a read-only public API for this type's published records.
type_editor.is_public_url_help: Published records only, filterable only on indexed fields, and never expanded.
type_editor.translatable_help: Records can exist in several languages ({locales}); each translation is its own record with its own slug.
type_editor.show_in_menu_help: Adds {label_plural} to the admin sidebar, in its own Records group right after Content.
type_editor.collection_help: Gives this type its own document and index tables. Chosen once — a type can't be moved between collections later.
type_editor.collection_immutable: A type can't be moved between collections once it is created.
type_editor.allowed_roles_help: Leave empty so anyone who can view or edit records can work with this type's records. Selecting roles narrows viewing and editing of its records to those roles; managing the type itself is never narrowed.
type_editor.display_field_help: The field a record is listed and linked by — its title in every list.
type_editor.live_notice: {count} live, {trashed} trashed records — changes are checked against them before they apply.
type_editor.field_key_locked: Can't be changed after the field is created.
type_editor.field_indexed_hint: The single most consequential choice on this screen: filterable and sortable, at the cost of a write per save.

key_error.reserved: "{key}" is reserved by the module: it names a column every record already has.
key_error.pattern: Must start with a lowercase letter, and contain only lowercase letters, numbers and underscores.
key_error.duplicate: Another field already uses this key.

type_editor.choices_paste_help: One per line. Separate the stored value from the label shown with "|" or "="; a line with neither is used as both.
type_editor.conflict_title: This type changed while you were editing
type_editor.conflict_help: Someone else saved a change to this type since you opened it. Reload to see the latest version, then reapply your changes.
type_editor.delete_help: Deletes this type and every record stored against it, including the trash. This cannot be undone.
type_editor.delete_confirm_description: This permanently deletes "{label}" and its {count} record(s) (live and trashed). Type {count} to confirm.
type_editor.delete_count_mismatch: That doesn't match. Type the exact number to confirm.
type_editor.referrers_notice: Other types still have a relation field pointing at this one:

last_applied.title: Last applied change left {count} record invalid
last_applied.title_one: Last applied change left {count} record invalid
last_applied.title_other: Last applied change left {count} records invalid
last_applied.help: They still hold their values and are still editable — opening one shows what no longer fits. This list is a sample of {shown} and is lost when you leave this page.

change.display_field_changed: Display title field changed — every record's title will be recomputed

preview.failed: The check could not be completed. Try previewing again.
preview.check_help: "Check records" runs the same dry run against the schema exactly as it is saved. Neither button writes anything.
preview.check_title: Records checked against the saved schema
preview.report_title: This change would leave records invalid
preview.orphaned_conflict: {key}: {count} records still hold a removed value
preview.apply_anyway: Apply anyway — {count} records will be marked invalid
preview.apply_anyway_description: {count} record(s) will be marked as not satisfying the schema, rather than being changed or deleted.
preview.conflicts_title: These fields still hold values from a previous delete
preview.conflicts_help: Restore brings those values back into the field; discard drops them for good.

revisions.title: Schema history
revisions.restore_confirm: Restore the schema from v{version}? This is checked the same way any other schema change is.

fields.no_choices: This field has no choices yet.
fields.unknown_type: This field type ({type}) is not editable in this version.

form.no_fields: This type has no fields yet. Add some on its schema screen.

relation.deleted_title: The record this pointed at has been deleted.
relation.no_target: This relation field has no target type configured.

validation.pattern: Does not match the required format
validation.url: Must be an http:// or https:// URL with a host
validation.decimals: At most {scale} decimal places are stored
validation.int_digits: At most {digits} digits before the decimal point
validation.position: Must be a whole number — use 0 for no particular order.
validation.datetime: Not a valid date and time
validation.choice: Not one of the configured choices
validation.json_shape: Must be a JSON object or array, not a scalar
validation.relation: Not a valid link to a record

io.trash_export_note: A trash export can't be re-imported — restore or purge the records first.
io.on_error_skip: Skip it and write the rest
io.force_help: Overwrite records whose version the file does not carry.
io.force_hint: These rows were refused because the file carries no version for a record that already exists — turn on "Overwrite unversioned rows" above and import again.
io.summary: {total} row(s): {created} to create, {updated} to update, {skipped} unchanged, {failed} failed
io.too_large: "{name}" is larger than the {limit} import limit.
io.error_unknown_format: Couldn't tell whether that file is JSON or CSV — save it with a .json or .csv extension and try again.
io.error_bad_json: That file isn't valid JSON — open it in a text editor and check it's complete.
io.errors_truncated: Only the first errors are listed; fix these and try again.
io.titles_unavailable: This report lists row numbers, not record titles — showing titles here would need the import endpoint to return them.
io.apply_blocked: {failed} of {total} row(s) can't be imported, so nothing will be written. Fix them and try again, or choose "Skip it and write the rest" under Import options.

type_io.will_update: Updates this type ({key}) from the definition.
type_io.create_help: Nothing about the type you are editing changes; you will land on the new type.
type_io.update_help: Checked against this type’s records first, exactly as the same change made here would be — anything it would break is reported instead of applied.
type_io.error_not_json: That file isn't valid JSON — open it in a text editor and check it's complete.
type_io.error_not_object: That file isn't a type definition: the top level has to be a JSON object.
type_io.error_missing_key: That definition has no "key", so there is no type to create or update.

widget.hint_not_public: Only public types render on the site.
widget.fields_picker_empty: Pick a record type above to choose its fields.
widget.field_filter: Filter (e.g. status:eq:paid — one term, indexed fields only)
widget.field_empty_text: Text shown when there are no records
widget.field_link_template: Link template ({slug} or {uuid}; blank = no link)
widget.field_api_prefix: Public API prefix (advanced — only change if the Records settings screen shows a different one)
